purpose: First unified neural proof of concept; not a reproduction of Jev's undisclosed internals

data.extra_paraphrase_questions: Six joint questions per in-distribution test scene
data.evaluation_speakers: Never present in any earlier baseline partition
data.held_compositions: One command/color pair per command excluded from train, dev, and calibration
data.scope_limit: Eight spoken words; four colors; four positions; generated 2x2 panels

architecture.candidate_head: One shared scalar scorer per supplied candidate; no fixed class output matrix
architecture.candidate_ids: Opaque mapping keys; never neural inputs
architecture.audio_initialization: Own earlier acoustic encoder; fixed eight-class head removed

training.selection: Lowest development macro normalized NLL over six joint question families
training.control_matching: Same initialization, training examples, and optimizer-step cap as nominated full run
training.final_test_rule: Nominate full model and controls before opening held-out metrics

verification.require_both_modalities: Compare six-task joint accuracy against separately trained unimodal controls
verification.question_semantics: Same inputs/candidates with spoken-vs-opposite and present-vs-absent questions
verification.candidate_subsets: 2, 3, and 4 supplied candidates without retraining; easier-choice diagnostic only
verification.calibration: One temperature on calibration split only
